text.en:
The articles specifically listed in "Annex A' hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978. as amended, shall be
subject to the rates of import duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite
each article as listed in the aforementioned "Annex".

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles specifically
listed in the aforesaid "Annex" which are entered or withdrawn from warehouses in the
Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty herein prescribed
IN REPLYING, PLEASE CITE
PFVR Letter:
1981841

All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately following its
complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
DONE in the City of Manila, this IIth day of June
Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Eight.
in the year of Our
By the President:
ALEXANDER P. AGUIRRE
Exedutive secretary
